PARCEL Fund — fractional real-estate token marketplace
Glass + electric violet: translucent blurred cards over an ambient violet/pink/mint wash on near-black. Space Grotesk display (uppercase hero), IBM Plex Mono on every number. Mint green always means yield or rent; pink is the secondary pop.

Everything is clickable: filter tabs, quick-buy presets, the token slider, tab switching, watchlists, claim rent. The accent color is a tweak chip above each artboard — violet, pink, mint or cyan.

All prices, yields, addresses and sponsor names are sample data for feeling out the flow — swap them before this goes anywhere real. The Reg D / 12-month lockup line on the buy panel is a placeholder too: your counsel decides the actual offering language.
